mapper.insert: insert into app.utilisateur (cip, pseudo, courriel, nom, prenom, photo_de_profil_id) values (#{cip}, #{username}, #{courriel}, #{nom}, #{prenom}, #{photoProfilId}) on conflict (cip) do update set pseudo = excluded.pseudo, courriel = excluded.courriel, nom = excluded.nom, prenom = excluded.prenom, photo_de_profil_id = excluded.photo_de_profil_id
mapper.select: SELECT u.cip, u.pseudo, u.courriel, u.nom, u.prenom, u.photo_de_profil_id FROM app.Contact c JOIN app.Utilisateur u ON c.cip_contact = u.cip WHERE c.cip = #{cip}
